4.0s: performer lifts front-left cup and begins rearranging cups; coin inside occluded by cup/hand — occlusion, not disappearance; 4 cups still present
6.0s: performer (blue suit, red tie) continues rearranging cups; 4 cups still visible; loose coins on table moved by performer's hands
8.0s: 4 cups aligned in a row, all clearly visible; performer's hands at rightmost cups; loose gold coins visible on table near cups
Cup group: count constant at 4 across all clearly visible moments (0s, 2s, 4s, 6s, 8s); no count change
Coin group: all count changes attributable to visible performer manipulation (drop into cup, cover with cup, slide across table); coins under moving cups are occluded, not vanished
Decorative medallions on red tablecloth border are printed fabric patterns, not countable physical objects — excluded from ledger
